development.subject: Double subscription payment
development.description: Two identical charges for one monthly billing cycle appear on the card statement.
development.rationale: Duplicate monthly payment, not wrong seat count or downgrade price.

development.subject: Revenue bars disappeared
development.description: The revenue chart is an empty white rectangle with no axes or bars.
development.rationale: Blank chart rendering; not missing Salesforce data or an entire dashboard spinner.

development.subject: Locked out of account
development.description: After entering the wrong password several times, I can no longer sign in.
development.rationale: Explicit failed-attempt lockout, not reset-token rejection.

development.subject: PDF export times out
development.description: A full year PDF report fails to export after thirty seconds.
development.rationale: Synchronous large PDF timeout, not delayed scheduled reports.

development.subject: Viewer can change widgets
development.description: A read-only teammate can rearrange widgets on the shared dashboard.
development.rationale: Viewer edit access is excessive; disabled export is expected permission behavior.

development.subject: Latest transactions missing
development.description: Recent transaction records are absent after the nightly sync and from the CSV download.
development.rationale: Both explicitly concern missing recent transactions; export notes link the sync issue.

development.subject: BigQuery warehouse connector problem
development.description: Our new BigQuery warehouse connector fails with an unknown connection error.
development.rationale: No BigQuery historical incident; HubSpot authentication and Salesforce stale data are not the same failure.

development.subject: Office delivery
development.description: A parcel containing a desk lamp was delivered to the wrong building.
development.rationale: No shipping or office delivery history.

development.subject: Printer paper jam
development.description: The office laser printer cannot feed paper from its tray.

held_out.subject: 429 errors on integration
held_out.description: Normal integration traffic is now being rejected with HTTP 429 even though usage did not increase.
held_out.rationale: Rate limit symptom; not HTTP 500 query parameter failures.

held_out.subject: HubSpot credentials rejected
held_out.description: A HubSpot connector that worked for months now says authentication failed.
held_out.rationale: Specific previously working connector auth failure.

held_out.subject: White page after Okta
held_out.description: After successful authentication with Okta the app redirects to an entirely blank screen.
held_out.rationale: SSO redirect blank page, distinct from chart rendering and provisioning roles.

held_out.subject: Dates change but chart does not
held_out.description: Choosing a custom date interval leaves the chart showing the old default interval.
held_out.rationale: Stale chart selection; T-1602 concerns slow updates rather than no update.

held_out.subject: Reports arrive hours late
held_out.description: Scheduled reports arrive hours behind schedule during the morning peak usage period.
held_out.rationale: Peak queue contention; not reports that stopped arriving entirely.

held_out.subject: Rotated key still grants access
held_out.description: After regenerating the API key the old one still authenticates requests.
held_out.rationale: API credential revocation delay; distinct from former employee session revocation.

held_out.subject: Invoice charges for too many people
held_out.description: We have eighteen active users but the invoice lists twenty-five seats.
held_out.rationale: Wrong seat count, not duplicate payment.

held_out.subject: Read-only teammate cannot download
held_out.description: The export button is disabled for a viewer who needs reports for a meeting.
held_out.rationale: Viewer export restriction, not viewer edit access or empty dashboard list.

held_out.subject: Our data warehouse integration with Snowflake is failing
held_out.description: Customer set up a new integration to sync data into their Snowflake warehouse and it's failing with an unclear connection error. This is a newer integration type we haven't seen many tickets about yet.
held_out.rationale: Supplied deliberately unsupported integration case; no historical Snowflake failure.

held_out.subject: Aquarium trouble
held_out.description: My aquarium filter has broken and fish need feeding.
held_out.rationale: No animal care or aquarium incidents.

held_out.subject: Mobile push notifications missing
held_out.description: The Android app never delivers push alerts when my phone is locked.
held_out.rationale: No mobile app push notification history; SMS 2FA is a different mechanism.

held_out.subject: Can't log in, password reset email never arrives
held_out.description: A customer requested a password reset an hour ago and says the email still hasn't shown up, even after checking spam.
held_out.rationale: Supplied NT-1 is not directly solved by T-1001 (email arrived, new password rejected) or T-1003 (SMS 2FA missing). Strict issue-level relevance rejects these tempting neighbors.
